name: Five Signets for War Supplies
summary: Orgrimmar's stores gather supplies for the Horde's campaign across Kalimdor. Workers earn commendation signets for their contributions, and Warlord Gorchuk exchanges them for supplies to equip the fighters.

sections.title: A Continent-Wide Effort
sections.body: Across Kalimdor, the Horde gathers raw goods, weapons, and provisions for a vast campaign. Gatherers and tradesfolk bring bandages, metals, and herbs into the cities, where military overseers award commendation signets for their work. The tokens mark each contribution to the stockpile growing along Orgrimmar's central avenues.

sections.title: Materiel for the Frontlines
sections.body: Warlord Gorchuk knows the wider war effort needs supplies, but each warrior also needs gear and provisions to survive the march into battle. Fighters can trade their commendation signets back into the Horde's stores for field supplies and surplus materiel, giving up personal recognition for what they need on the front.

faq.q: What is the purpose of turning in five signets?
aliases: what do i get for 5 signets
faq.answer: Five signets let you exchange commendation tokens earned through the Horde's mobilization for personal gear and field supplies instead of keeping them for political recognition.
Warlord Gorchuk is a Horde military coordinator in Orgrimmar who manages supplies and approves requisitions for warriors preparing for conflict.

faq.q: How do you obtain Horde Commendation Signets?
faq.answer: Quartermasters and logistics officers across the Horde award signets when you contribute raw materials, food, bandages, and crafting resources to the faction's war effort.
Yes. Warlord Gorchuk approves further exchanges when you bring more required batches of signets to support the troops.

faq.q: Why does Gorchuk say I won't receive recognition for this exchange?
faq.answer: When you spend your commendation signets on personal supplies, the quartermaster's caches provide the goods instead of recording your deeds. You give up formal accolades for practical field supplies.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
faq.answer: The exchange takes place in Orgrimmar, where stockpiles and logistics coordinators prepare the Horde for war.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, every crate and bundle gathered in Orgrimmar helps supply your faction against the threats ahead.
As a warrior, you may value survival in the front lines over ceremonial recognition, making Gorchuk's supplies worth your accumulated signets.
